content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NSC Delhi Junior Mentor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the NSC Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the National Science Centre Delhi recruitment is Junior Mentor.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Mentor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Mentor position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Mentor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering in 1st class in specific disciplines like Robotics, Computers, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, or Mechatronics, along with one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Mentor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to the Junior Mentor post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Junior Mentor post is 31 years.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Aptitude & Communication Skill Test is scheduled for 2 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Mentor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-In Aptitude Test and a Communication Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the National Science Centre Delhi located?
faq.answer: The National Science Centre Delhi is located in Delhi, with a pincode of 110001.
